Chapter 195: Chapter 3 Martial Tao Shouldn’t Be So Trivial (Please Subscribe)_2

…

Virtual World.

Canglan Evolution Academy large classroom.

Classes had not yet begun, but thousands of students had arrived early, taken their seats, and were waiting eagerly.

“Have you heard, the one lecturing us this time is Lin Yuan, the champion of the arena competition, Lin Yuan himself.”

“Nonsense, could I have come so early if I hadn’t heard about it?”

...

“That’s Lin Yuan we’re talking about. In the tens of thousands of years of Canglan Star, he is the evolver with the strongest evolutionary talent who stepped into the Fourth Rank before the age of one hundred.”

“Yeah, being a Second Layer Evolver before I’m a hundred would satisfy me.”

“You’re thinking about Second Layer?”

…

The thousands of students began to discuss softly.

The students who could sit in this classroom were the most potential-filled students of Canglan Evolution Academy and represented the future hope of Canglan Star.

At this moment, everyone was filled with anticipation, waiting for the arrival of the lecturer.

Whoosh.

Just then.

A young man appeared on the podium.

The next moment.

The classroom fell completely silent.

All students fixated their eyes on the young man.

“Hello, everyone.”

Lin Yuan casually greeted.

As an honorary professor at Canglan Evolution Academy,

Lin Yuan enjoyed the many privileges and benefits of a professor’s level, and although he was only an honorary professor, he still had to at least deliver one or two lectures.

Half an hour later.

Lin Yuan had finished citing the textbook material verbatim.

He then began to ask the students about the problems they encountered on their evolutionary path.

“Mr. Lin.”

A girl with a ponytail raised her hand.

“You ask.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“Thank you, Mr. Lin.”

The ponytailed girl was somewhat surprised; many students had raised their hands simultaneously, yet Lin Yuan had chosen her.

“Mr. Lin, my development pathway is the Martial Path Evolutionary Path…”

The ponytailed girl volunteered her evolutionary path.

This was quite normal, as every evolutionary path had distinct features, and revealing the specific path one was cultivating helped the teacher better frame the subsequent questions.

“Martial Path, huh…”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Nowadays, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had become the most popular evolutionary path on Canglan Star.

Of the thousands of students present, at least a tenth were pursuing the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Of course, these students had just started practicing, and the vast majority were not yet ranked.

“I see that later in the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, it requires the comprehension of both Taiyin and Taiyang forces, but I am naturally slow to sense these two kinds of power. Does this mean I’m not suited for the Martial Path?”

The ponytailed girl timidly asked.

With this question,

the other students instantly perked up their ears.

They, too, wanted to know the answer to this question since Taiyin and Taiyang energies belonged to the higher echelons of energy, not perceived by just anyone.

Most evolvers were still more sensitive to the basic energies of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth.

“This question…”

Lin Yuan looked around.

If he had to answer, Lin Yuan could indeed provide one.

That would be that everything possesses Yin and Yang, such as the Thunder Attributes, which also have distinctions of Yin and Yang, along with metal, wood, water, fire, and earth.

Even if you do not have the ability to comprehend Taiyin and Taiyang, you can still sense what you are capable of perceiving, such as the Power of Gold, and after comprehending the Power of Gold entirely, delve into its aspects of Yin and Yang, subsequently leading to Taiyin and Taiyang energies.

However.

This answer, though understandable to Lin Yuan and likely other Fifth or Sixth Rank Evolvers,

most of the unranked evolver students present would not understand.

Not only would they not understand,

but they also wouldn’t be able to achieve it.

Given that,

Lin Yuan didn’t want to say it.

“I am also researching this problem.”

“Once I have the results, I will definitely let you know,”

Lin Yuan spoke.

“Alright.”

The ponytailed girl didn’t find it strange.

Although Lin Yuan’s evolutionary talent was considered the best on Canglan Star,

compared to that mysterious scholar who had founded the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, he naturally fell short.

It was perfectly normal for Lin Yuan not to know the answer to a question that even that mysterious scholar hadn’t explained.

…

After completing the lecture,

Lin Yuan disconnected from the Virtual World.

Sitting cross-legged in the underground training field,

the question from the ponytailed girl during the class

had plunged Lin Yuan into deep thought.

For a long time.

Lin Yuan established the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

It was entirely based on his own perspective.

First Tier Chapter.

Second Layer Chapter.

The Yin Yang Chapter in the Second Layer Chapter.

Third Rank Chapter, Taiyin Rule, Taiyang Rule.

Fourth Rank Chapter.

Fifth Rank Chapter, Taiyin Primordial Spirit, Taiyang Divine Spirit, Taiji Primordial Spirit.

Everything was completely based on himself.

But who was Lin Yuan?

He possessed Against-Heaven’s Understanding, could infer tenfold, a hundredfold from one fact.

Lin Yuan could understand, could realize, could absorb; could others do the same?

For instance, the Taiyin Taiyang Taiji, the content of the Second Layer Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

But wanting to grasp Taiji, let alone Taiji, even just Taiyin or Taiyang was exceedingly difficult for others.

In the Dragon Tiger World, those who had realized the Taiyang Pole Extreme and the Taiyin Pole Extreme were Heavenly Masters unmatched in hundreds to thousands of years.

And they still needed the true martial sword to achieve this.

The cultivation environment of the Main World, although far superior to the Dragon Tiger World, did not provide many resources for the most ordinary citizens.

“From the Second Layer Chapter onwards, martial arts are no longer applicable to ordinary citizens…”

Lin Yuan’s expression remained calm, his thoughts churning.

With the current Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

The Second Layer Chapter required realizing one of the Taiyin or Taiyang.

If one couldn’t realize it, it would be very difficult to advance further.

One could foresee, countless citizens would be trapped at this step.

Lin Yuan slowly closed his eyes.

Martial arts should not be so limited.

At that moment, numerous insights surged up in his mind.

Recently, in the Founder’s Virtual World, he conversed with that mysterious existence, who had left behind posts from 23,000 years ago, about controlling myriad things other than Taiji; the other myriad Dao techniques were quickly utilized by Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan started from the Second Layer Chapter, re-integrating martial arts, and removed the restriction that progress required solely Taiyin or Taiyang.

From now on, Martial Dao Cultivators were not confined to Taiyin or Taiyang alone. As long as one could sense it, powers like metal, wood, water, fire, earth, thunder, ice, and many others were all acceptable for continued cultivation.

Starting from the Second Layer, one would determine a path that suits oneself, and by the Fifth Rank, condense out the corresponding attribute’s Primordial Spirit.

The Primordial Spirits mentioned here are not only Yin God and Yang Spirit, but also Golden Primordial Spirit, Water Spirit, and Wood Spirit are possible.

Endless and infinite.

Inclusive of all things.

Just as Lin Yuan was perfecting the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Boom.

His soul suddenly began to vibrate intensely.

Immediately his aura began to change, slowly transitioning towards the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“Didn’t expect that…”

“This is indeed the best way for me to break through to the Sixth Rank…”

Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

Perfecting the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, freeing it from the limitations of Taiyin and Taiyang, directly allowed Lin Yuan to seize the best opportunity to break through to the Sixth Rank.

This opportunity, many Fifth Rank ultimate Evolvers might not catch even in tens to hundreds of years.

Even the previous Lin Yuan was hesitating about how to break through to the Sixth Rank.

But now, everything was very clear. This natural breakthrough was undoubtedly the most perfect path to stepping into the Sixth Rank.

…

A month later.

Lin Yuan emerged from seclusion.

Breaking through from the Fifth Rank to the Sixth Rank wasn’t something that could be achieved in a short time; it required the soul’s slow transformation and transition.

“Rest for a while.”

Lin Yuan planned to balance work with rest.

He was not like those Evolvers who were nearing their life’s limit.

At his current age, Lin Yuan was only twenty years old, with plenty of time to enjoy life.

“Hmm?”

“So many people looking for me?”

Lin Yuan opened the information panel and discovered that during his seclusion many people had visited him, but because he was in seclusion, they had been dealt with by his smart assistant.

Yet still, seven or eight people insisted on meeting Lin Yuan.

They were still waiting for him to come out.

“Let’s meet them then.”

Lin Yuan clicked approve.

Instantly there appeared a middle-aged man with golden hair in front of him.

“Pu’an Star Domain, Xiangwen Group, Zhou He greets Mr. Lin Yuan.”

The middle-aged man with golden hair slightly bowed and said respectfully.

“Xiangwen Group?” Lin Yuan thought for a moment.

He immediately recalled that this group was a rather famous one in the Pu’an Star Domain, with a Sixth Rank Fallen Star Warrior in its ranks.

The Pu’an Star Domain was a Star Domain next to the Chikun Star Domain, and due to its proximity, it had frequent trade interactions with many powers in the Chikun Star Domain.

“Speak.”

“What’s the matter?”

Lin Yuan spoke casually.

“Our Xiangwen Group sincerely invites Mr. Lin Yuan to become a member of our next tournament’s preparatory team,”

“as long as Mr. Lin Yuan agrees, the conditions are up to you,”

the middle-aged man with golden hair said.

“You mean, let me join your group and then participate in the next tournament?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the middle-aged man with golden hair.
